lines.text: Fans make characters famous. They don't own them, and they never get a say in what happens next.
KOMA changes that. An AI comic costs ten cents a page, and its hero can become a character with its own wallet and its own coin.
Holders propose the next episode, vote for free, and Chainlink settles the winner on chain.
Every vote, trade and payment is a transaction. On Monad, they land in a fraction of a second, and fans never pay gas.
This is Monad testnet, live. A block every three hundred milliseconds, final in about six hundred.
We connect a wallet that holds no MON at all, and back Signal Fire. One signature, no gas, executed in under half a second.
That buy filled the curve, so the series graduated into its own Uniswap v4 pool.
lines.say: That buy filled the curve, so the series graduated into its own Uniswap v-four pool.

lines.text: Holders write what happens next. We pitch episode three, and Tencent's Hunyuan 3 turns the idea into a pitch.
One AUSD payment over x402. Kimi reads the canon so far and writes the script, and FLUX draws it on model.
lines.say: One A-U-S-D payment over x-four-oh-two. Kimi reads the canon so far and writes the script, and FLUX draws it on model.

lines.text: It's minted to us, and proposed as episode three.
Voting is a free signature. Four more team wallets vote too. This is seeded activity, and we label it that way.
When the window closes, a Chainlink CRE workflow re-checks all five votes on Monad and settles the winner.
lines.say: When the window closes, a Chainlink C-R-E workflow re-checks all five votes on Monad and settles the winner.

lines.text: Episode three is canon. The fans wrote it.
And next week's twist waits in the Writers' Room, encrypted to a passkey.
KOMA. Fans write the canon. Live on Monad testnet.
